reference_facts.text: The issue affects the Android app
Email+password login hangs and ends with a 'request timed out' error
The issue appeared after updating from version 3.2.0
The issue reproduces on both wifi and mobile data
Google sign-in works, only email+password login is affected

output_facts.text: On the Meridian Android app version 3.2.1, after entering a password and tapping login, the loading spinner runs indefinitely
On the Meridian Android app version 3.2.1, the email+password login attempt eventually results in the app displaying 'request timed out'
Only email+password login is affected; 'Sign in with Google' works normally
The login issue started after updating the app from version 3.2.0 (which worked) to 3.2.1
The affected app is the Meridian fitness app on Android, version 3.2.1
The issue was not reproduced on iOS (single data point: the reporter's wife's iPhone works fine)
The issue occurs on both Wi-Fi and mobile data
Reinstalling the app did not resolve the issue
As a workaround, use the 'Sign in with Google' button instead of email+password login
